fichas.title: Communal Storerooms for Bicycles and Prams
fichas.summary: Communal storerooms are required for prams, pushchairs and bicycles in residential building classes 3–5, and should also be provided in other residential buildings and detached houses. Plan for at least one vehicle per occupant, including children, and allow for mopeds, tricycles and trailers. Rooms should preferably be at street level, lockable, and fitted with hooks and bicycle stands. They may be inside the building with access to the entrance or in separate bicycle sheds; provide additional outdoor bicycle stands, especially when the storeroom is in the cellar. The illustrated bicycle/pram room is an example for about 20 vehicles.

fichas.title: Cellar Compartment in a Residential Building
fichas.summary: Storage for each flat normally includes an in-flat storeroom and additional storage outside the flat, usually as a cellar compartment. An inexpensive alternative is a parking shed in the grounds. Cellar storerooms should be dry and well ventilated; natural lighting is recommended, and careful detailing of the window opening can improve light entry. The illustrated cellar compartment includes a light shaft and steel shelf.
uses: Store household belongings outside the flat
Provide natural light and ventilation to storage space
